projects.title: Verbasense
projects.shortDesc: Smart IoT backlight that detects hand raises in classrooms using AI.
projects.fullDesc:
Verbasense is a classroom participation tool that solves the problem of students struggling to get a teacher's attention in large classes.

Using an ESP32 microcontroller and a Python AI pipeline, the system detects when a student raises their hand and activates a backlight to visually signal the teacher. A Flutter mobile app gives teachers a real-time view of classroom participation.

The project was awarded at a school-wide hackathon, receiving recognition for AI innovation, technical robustness, and entrepreneurial potential.

projects.title: DIY Variable Capacitor
projects.shortDesc: Custom disk-style variable capacitor designed and 3D printed using Fusion 360.
projects.fullDesc:
A disk-style variable capacitor designed entirely in Fusion 360 and fabricated using additive manufacturing techniques.

The design allows capacitance to be adjusted mechanically by rotating the disk array, enabling fine-tuned control for use in electronics experiments and RF circuits. Every component was designed from scratch with precise tolerances to ensure reliable electrical performance.

This project was an exploration into bridging mechanical design with electrical engineering fundamentals.

projects.title: Battle of the Ice Cream Cup
projects.shortDesc: Lifecycle analysis comparing environmental impact of different ice cream cup materials.
projects.fullDesc:
A comprehensive lifecycle analysis (LCA) comparing the environmental footprint of paper, plastic, and biodegradable ice cream cup alternatives.

The study evaluated each material from raw material extraction through production, use, and disposal — considering energy consumption, carbon emissions, and waste generation across each stage.

Findings revealed nuanced trade-offs: biodegradable alternatives are not always the most eco-friendly option depending on regional waste infrastructure, consumer behavior, and end-of-life processing.
